violations.quote: Every picked item is scan-verified before it is packed under PR-04.
violations.explanation: The official facts state that Procedure PR-05 is titled Packing and labelling, not PR-04.

violations.quote: Adjustments arising from the daily cycle count are prepared by the stock controllers and approved only by the shift supervisor.
violations.explanation: Fact F-RSP-01 requires only the warehouse manager to sign off stocktake results.

violations.quote: Zone F holds only quarantine, returns and hazmat in the cage
violations.explanation: The fact states Zone F holds the value-added services area, not only those three uses.
